message: Example is missing response.body for NotFoundError; Fern declares NotFoundError with a body schema from the 404 response of another operation.

"NotFoundError" is not an error this operation declares. Fern names errors after their status codes (for example 404 becomes NotFoundError); this operation declares no error responses (status codes 400-599, 4XX or 5XX).

"InternalServerError" is not an error this operation declares. Fern names errors after their status codes (for example 404 becomes NotFoundError); this operation declares: NotFoundError (404), ServiceUnavailableError (503), ClientRequestError (4XX).

"Not found" is not an error this operation declares. Fern names errors after their status codes (for example 404 becomes NotFoundError); this operation declares: NotFoundError (404), ServiceUnavailableError (503), ClientRequestError (4XX).
Invalid NotFoundError response example at "/title": Expected example to be a string. Example is: 404
Example is missing response.body for NotFoundError; the 404 response of this operation has a body schema.
